name: 17102 · Harrisburg, PA
findings: ZIP 17102 (Harrisburg) has 126 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17102 (Harrisburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17102 (Harrisburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 64 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
